title: 第31章 白月光初恋？第一个S级绑定任务
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

趁着系统还在结算中。

江辰忍不住质问道：“系统，方才亲了那么久，你怎么一点提示没有？”

按理说，直接性接吻任务，亲一口就算任务完成了。

【咳咳...本系统这不是为了不打扰宿主的好事吗？】

江辰：额……我信你个鬼，你个糟老系统坏得很。

【叮！奖励结算完毕，恭喜宿主获得以下奖励！】

【奖励1：财富投资回报100，000元！（当前财富积累总值：27w）】

【奖励2：幸运大转盘抽奖次数+1】

【奖励3：系统可在绑定精神小妹‘苏念’后，升级为LV2（绑定条件：3名以上B级以上精神小妹）】

【精神小妹‘苏念’对宿主好感度为68，精神等级评定为B+，符合绑定条件，请问是否绑定？】

“你这不是废话吗？赶紧给老子绑定！”

【叮！系统已满足升级为LV2条件，请问……啊不，系统正在自动升级中……】

江辰：你小子，总算学乖了一回。

【叮！财富投资回报系统已升级！】

【当前等级：LV2】

【每日消费返现额度：10000元（次日零时刷新），且额度使用免费】

【当前返现倍数：20】

【随机财富回报任务发布率：20%】

【其他特殊权限及隐藏功能，需要宿主在使用中自行开发！】

随着机械声消失，江辰心脏的位置猛然一跳。

每日消费额度和返现倍数都获得了翻倍！且消费额度是免费使用的。

换句话说，他只要完成每日10000元消费，就能净赚20万！

此外，还出现了一个叫‘随机财富回报任务发布率’的东西？

江辰想了想。

应该是以后系统任务的数量会增加。

这对他而言，赫然是一件财源广进的好事！

既能打脸社会上的各种人才，又能用麻袋捡钱，岂不美哉？

还有最后一点，其他特殊权限及隐藏功能，需要他自行开发？

听起来神神秘秘的，但也让江辰越发期待后续。

就在这时。

“哥，说话啊！”

见江辰没有任何表示，苏念撩起裙子，直接坐到他腿上，“你就说，你想不想磕一下嘛～”

说着话，似是为了勾引江辰。

磨盘大的蜜桃臀微微动了起来。

旁边，有好几对情侣都注意到了江辰这一边的情况。

脸上不约而同露出吃瓜看戏的目光。

“卧槽，不是吧？这就干起来了！现在的年轻人，还真是放得开啊！”

“别说他俩了，我也想在电影院里干这事了！那感觉，太他妈刺激了！”

“……”

由于苏念的动作幅度比较大，不少人已经自动联想了。

江辰回过神来，脸色猛然一变。

这小妮子，胆子也太大了吧？

我这都一句话没说，她就自己上来，还自己动起来了？

江辰心中那叫一个哭笑不得。

他可不想进行现场直播，然后被人挂到网上去。

“念念……”

江辰刚要开口，苏念突然打断了他，“哥，别说话……”

江辰顿时语塞。

额……刚刚不是你让我说话的吗？

这时，一双白皙的藕臂，像蛇一样缠上了他的脖子。

“哥，我就不信，你对我没有一点想法。”

苏念说着，她上衣的那几枚扣子，不知从什么时候开始解开了。

随着她身体轻微晃动，呼之欲出一抹白皙。

江辰眼睛一直，下意识忍不住咽了咽。

“念念，我...”

就在江辰想要说点什么的时候，苏念突然按住他的脑袋，往胸前猛地一送！

“唔...”

事发突然，江辰根本没有反应时间。

Page (1/3)

While the system is still settling.

Jiang Chen couldn't help but ask: "System, we kissed for so long just now, why didn't you give me any warning?"

It stands to reason that for a direct kissing task, the task is completed with just one kiss.

[Ahem...Isn't this a good thing for this system to not disturb the host?】

Jiang Chen: Uh...I believe you, you are a bastard and your system is very bad.

【bite!The rewards have been settled. Congratulations to the host for receiving the following rewards!】

[Reward 1: Wealth investment return of 100,000 yuan!(Current total wealth accumulation: 27w)]

[Reward 2: Number of Lucky Wheel draws +1]

[Reward 3: The system can be upgraded to LV2 after binding the spiritual girl ‘Su Nian’ (binding condition: 3 or more B-level or above spiritual girls)]

[Spiritual girl ‘Su Nian’ has a favorable opinion of the host of 68 and a mental rating of B+, which meets the binding conditions. Do you want to bind her?】

"Aren't you talking nonsense? Hurry up and bind me!"

[Ding!The system has met the conditions for upgrading to LV2. Excuse me...ah no, the system is being automatically upgraded...]

Jiang Chen: You kid, you finally learned your lesson.

【bite!The wealth investment return system has been upgraded!】

[Current level: LV2]

[Daily consumption cashback limit: 10,000 yuan (refreshed at 0:00 the next day), and the limit is free to use]

[Current cashback multiple: 20]

[Random wealth return task release rate: 20%]

[Other special permissions and hidden functions need to be developed by the host during use!】

As the mechanical sound disappeared, Jiang Chen's heart suddenly jumped.

The daily consumption limit and cashback multiplier have been doubled!And the consumption quota is free to use.

In other words, as long as he completes daily consumption of 10,000 yuan, he can make a net profit of 200,000 yuan!

In addition, there is something called the ‘Random Wealth Return Task Release Rate’?

Jiang Chen thought for a while.

It should be that the number of system tasks will increase in the future.

For him, this is a good thing that will bring him great wealth!

Isn't it wonderful to be able to slap all kinds of talents in society in the face and pick up money with a sack?

And lastly, does he need to develop other special permissions and hidden functions by himself?

It sounds mysterious, but it also makes Jiang Chen look forward to the follow-up.

Just then.

"Brother, talk!"

Seeing that Jiang Chen didn't express anything, Su Nian lifted up her skirt and sat directly on his lap, "Just tell me, do you want to kowtow~"

He spoke as if to seduce Jiang Chen.

The peach buttocks as big as a millstone moved slightly.

Next to him, there were several couples who noticed the situation on Jiang Chen's side.

The look on his face showed the look of eating melon and watching a show.

"Damn it, isn't it? Let's get started! Today's young people are really open-minded!"

"Don't talk about them, I want to do this in the cinema too! It feels so damn exciting!"

"..."

Because Su Nian's movements were relatively large, many people had automatically associated it with him.

Jiang Chen came back to his senses and his expression suddenly changed.

This little girl is too courageous, right?

I didn't even say a word, but she came up on her own and started moving on her own?

Jiang Chen felt dumbfounded in his heart.

He didn't want to broadcast live and then be posted online.

"Nian Nian..."

Just as Jiang Chen was about to speak, Su Nian suddenly interrupted him, "Brother, stop talking..."

Jiang Chen was immediately speechless.

Um...didn't you ask me to speak just now?

At this time, a pair of white lotus-rooted arms wrapped around his neck like a snake.

"Brother, I don't believe it. You have no idea about me."

As Su Nian said, the buttons on her top were unbuttoned at some point.

As her body swayed slightly, a flash of whiteness was about to appear.

Jiang Chen kept his eyes open and subconsciously couldn't help but swallow.

"Nian Nian, I..."

Just when Jiang Chen was about to say something, Su Nian suddenly held down his head and pushed it to his chest!

"Well..."

The incident happened so suddenly that Jiang Chen had no time to react.
